records.title: Access Scholarship — August 2027 CFA exams
records.location: India — eligible residents applying to the global CFA programme
records.benefit: Exam registration reduced to US$400 plus applicable tax, including the Premium package and Practice Pack.
records.duration: One exam cycle: August 2027, Levels I, II or III
records.eligibility: Meet CFA programme entry requirements and demonstrate financial need. Current exam registration, employer funding and overlapping scholarship applications can make you ineligible.
records.description: A finance qualification subsidy accessible from India. The next application window begins on 3 November; it is not open on the verification date.
records.applicationSteps: Read the scholarship rules before paying for an exam. Apply through CFA Institute's linked scholarship portal using a computer during the window.
records.evidence: Official schedule lists 3–23 November 2026 for August 2027 exams; decisions are scheduled for 18 December.
records.caveat: Competitive fee reduction, not a fully funded qualification. The remaining US$400 and tax are payable; the award cannot move to another exam cycle.

records.title: CFA Student Scholarship
records.location: India — students at participating CFA-affiliated institutions
records.format: Online application through an affiliated institution
records.benefit: CFA exam registration reduced to US$600 plus applicable tax.
records.duration: One scholarship award; use within the award's permitted exam period
records.eligibility: Enrolled at an institution participating in CFA Institute's University Affiliation Program, meeting CFA entry requirements and not already registered for an exam.
records.description: Institution-linked assistance for India-based students preparing for the CFA qualification. Check your university's participation before applying.
records.applicationSteps: Check your university's affiliation and any additional documents or internal deadline. Submit the application through the official scholarship portal.
records.evidence: Live application portal specifies 1 September 2026 opening and 15 July 2027, 11:59 p.m. EDT deadline.
records.caveat: Restricted to affiliated institutions; awards are not automatic. US$600 plus tax remains payable. The displayed portal deadline is in US Eastern time; university cutoffs may be earlier.

records.title: CFA Professor Scholarship
records.benefit: CFA exam registration reduced to US$600 plus applicable tax.
records.duration: One award, subject to the specified exam-use period
records.eligibility: Full-time university professors teaching at least six credit hours per semester/quarter, or administrators/department heads teaching at least three. CFA entry and registration restrictions apply.
records.description: Supports eligible faculty in India pursuing the CFA programme alongside their teaching work.
records.applicationSteps: Prepare employment evidence, CV and an institution letter confirming teaching hours. Apply through the official Professor Scholarship portal.
records.evidence: The live 2026–27 portal lists 1 September opening and 15 August 2027 closing; teaching thresholds appear on CFA Institute's programme page.
records.caveat: US$600 plus tax remains payable. Deadline conflict: the live portal says 15 August; the general information page says 31 July annually. Apply by July and verify with CFA Institute.

records.org: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
records.title: CA student scholarships and merit awards
records.benefit: Monthly support: Foundation ₹1,500; need-based Intermediate/Final ₹2,500; Final merit-need ₹4,000; Final merit ₹5,000.
records.duration: Foundation: four months. Intermediate: eight months, with conditional extensions. Final: up to 24 months or remaining articleship.
records.eligibility: Registered CA students. Need-based parental income ceiling: ₹5 lakh/year. Final merit-need requires Intermediate ranks 11–50; merit award ranks 1–10. Final students must commence articleship.
records.description: Stage-specific funding under ICAI's revised 2026 scholarship scheme.
records.applicationSteps: Apply in the Self Service Portal with income and registration evidence as relevant. Arrange the required CA/principal recommendation; applications are considered quarterly.
records.evidence: Official FAQ updated 15 May 2026 explicitly permits applications at any time and shows the revised award table.
records.caveat: Payments and continuation depend on the applicable scheme, verification and progress. These are scholarships, separate from an employer's articleship stipend.

records.org: Government of Kerala — Directorate of Minority Welfare
records.title: CA / CMA / CS scholarship — Kerala minorities
records.benefit: ₹15,000 education support for eligible CA, CMA or CS students.
records.duration: 2026–27 scholarship cycle; award subject to department rules
records.eligibility: Kerala residents from notified minority communities preparing for CA/CMA/CS Intermediate or Final. BPL applicants receive priority; published income ceiling is ₹8 lakh. Academic and residence documents are required.
records.description: A targeted professional-accountancy scholarship, with a currently published application window.
records.applicationSteps: Register on the minority-welfare scholarship portal and complete your profile and qualifications. Select CA/ICWA CMA/CS, upload evidence and follow the current notification's submission requirements.
records.evidence: Government portal lists 13 October–25 November 2026. Kerala's Career Prayanam government portal confirms ₹15,000 and the ₹8 lakh income ceiling.
records.caveat: Kerala and community eligibility apply; this is not an all-India scholarship. The English guideline download still carries a 2025–26 heading, so use the 2026–27 notification for final document and academic conditions.

records.title: Funded PhD in Economics & Finance — January 2027
records.benefit: Institute fellowship ₹37,000/month; potential increase to ₹40,000–₹42,000 after two years based on performance, plus ₹20,000 annual contingency.
records.duration: Full-time PhD; fellowship support up to five years
records.eligibility: A qualifying relevant degree, normally at least 60% under the central admissions criteria; departmental shortlisting and written test/interview apply. Check the brochure for your exact qualification.
records.description: Research areas include quantitative finance, corporate finance, accounting and economics. The department has a specific January 2027 admission call.
records.applicationSteps: Read the current PhD brochure and departmental research areas. Use the application link on the official BITS admissions page before 6 November; the department lists its test/interview on 27 November.
records.evidence: Official department notice and its poster confirm the finance intake and deadline; the central 2026–27 admissions page details fellowship funding.
records.caveat: Funding described is for full-time admitted scholars; do not assume part-time admission includes a stipend. Admission, tuition and living charges remain governed by the brochure.

records.org: Indian Council of Social Science Research
records.title: Senior Fellowship — public-finance research route
records.location: India — eligible affiliating university or research institution
records.benefit: ₹45,000/month and ₹40,000 annual contingency; exceptional salary-protection cases have separate rules.
records.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 45–70 with a PhD, substantial research publications and affiliation to an eligible Indian institution. Previous ICSSR award and cooling-off restrictions apply.
records.description: An established-researcher route for a suitable public-finance/economics proposal within the wider social-science fellowship scheme.
records.applicationSteps: Confirm subject fit and institutional affiliation against the fellowship guidelines. Submit the prescribed online application and research-proposal format; obtain institutional forwarding.
records.evidence: Current second-call notice explicitly lists 21 October opening and 20 November 2026, 6 p.m. closing; scheme page specifies eligibility and funding.
records.caveat: For senior researchers, not a graduate-entry fellowship. This is a broad social-science call; finance applicants must establish a suitable research proposal and subject fit.

records.org: Institute of Company Secretaries of India
records.title: CS Students Education Fund Trust — verify application route
records.benefit: Conditional reimbursement/support for specified CS registration and examination fees under SEFT rules.
records.duration: Progress-linked support through eligible CS stages
records.eligibility: Published need-based route: family income up to ₹3 lakh, with 65% in Class XII or 60% in graduation. Merit route: 85% in Class XII or 70% in graduation without the income ceiling.
records.description: A relevant professional-course funding route, retained for follow-up rather than counted as a verified live call.
records.applicationSteps: Ask ICSI student services for the current SEFT application form and applicable rules before paying fees. Prepare marksheets and income evidence; confirm first-attempt and registration-time conditions.
records.evidence: Official student-services directory links the SEFT guidelines; 2026 ICSI journal material continues to describe the scheme. Linked forms were not reliably accessible during verification.
records.caveat: Current form availability and submission acceptance remain unverified. This is not labelled open; stage, first-attempt and reimbursement conditions must be confirmed directly.

records.org: Institute of Cost Accountants of India
records.title: CMA fee waivers and scholarships — scheme directory
records.benefit: Fee support varies by Foundation merit, Intermediate financial-need, disability and university-rank schemes.
records.duration: Depends on course stage and scheme
records.eligibility: Separate academic, financial, disability or university-rank criteria apply. Choose the scheme corresponding to your CMA stage and circumstances.
records.description: ICMAI's official index brings together several distinct cost-accountancy funding routes.
records.applicationSteps: Open the relevant scheme from the official financial-aid directory. Confirm current terms and availability with ICMAI before completing the linked form.
records.evidence: Official directory currently lists Foundation merit, Intermediate economically challenged, physically challenged and national university-rank scholarship schemes.
records.caveat: A public 2026 application window could not be verified; several linked rule PDFs returned access errors. This directory is a watchlist resource, not proof of an open award.

records.title: FRM scholarship through a GARP Academic Partner
records.benefit: A limited scholarship route for FRM Part I; obtain the current fee coverage from the nominating institution.
records.eligibility: Students or faculty in eligible GARP Academic Partner programmes. The programme administrator nominates candidates; this is not a general direct-application award.
records.description: A useful way to reduce risk-qualification costs if your Indian institution participates in GARP's academic network.
records.applicationSteps: Check your institution and programme against GARP's Academic Partner list. Ask its programme administrator about current nominations, selection and fee coverage.
records.evidence: GARP's FAQ restricts scholarships to partner-programme nominations and describes six student and one faculty nominations per programme annually.
records.caveat: No public India-wide application window was verified. Your programme may not participate or may have exhausted nominations; do not assume a full fee waiver.

records.title: Securities Markets PGDM scholarships — next intake watch
records.format: Full-time campus programme with conditional tuition aid
records.benefit: Published merit route offers 50% tuition support to selected qualifying entrants; continuation has academic conditions.
records.eligibility: Admission and scholarship selection are separate. Published merit criteria combine first-class graduation with specified entrance-test percentiles; second-year continuation requires academic performance.
records.description: A finance-specific study-and-funding route worth tracking for the next announced admission cycle.
records.applicationSteps: Monitor NISM's official programme page for the next dated admission notice. Review total course costs and each scholarship's conditions before applying.
records.evidence: The currently published 2026–28 application deadline was 15 April 2026. The page describes scholarship arrangements but does not establish a new open intake.
records.caveat: 2026–28 admissions are closed; no 2027–29 window was verified. Tuition aid does not automatically cover every fee, accommodation or living cost.

exclusions.title: Generic bank-sponsored school and undergraduate scholarships
